žöbšijen: žöbši- — to approve, assent (Ming 道是 'say it is so'); -jen, converb ending (uncertain), 'agreeing' (verb, converb; uncertain) [道是]

aγ̇ulžaγ̇ulžu: aγ̇ulža- — to have an audience, be received; causative -γ̇ul- + converb -žu, 'having (them) received' (verb, causative converb; Ming 拜見 'meet in audience') [敎拜見着]
süjü-ġer: süjü — teaching, admonition (word uncertain, from the Ming 敎誨); instrumental -ġer, 'with admonition' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [敎誨]

ajalažu: ajala- — to go on campaign (stem inferred from the Ming 征進); converb -žu, 'going on campaign' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [征進着]
odorun: od- — to go (Ming 去); converb of time -orun (linking vowel -o- + -run), 'when going' (verb, converb) [去時]
žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間] · also 'among, between' (Ming 間), in žaba žaγ̇ura dürüžu, 'into the crevice' · also 'meanwhile, in the meantime' (Ming 其間)
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
čerig-ün: čerig — soldier, army (noun); genitive -ün, 'of the army' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [軍的]
haran-u: haran — common people, men (noun) + genitive -u, 'of the people' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [人的]
čirai: čirai — face, countenance (noun; Ming 顏色 'colour of the face') [顏色]
quγulžü: quγul- — to break off; converb -žü, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [折着]
odba: od- — to go; past -ba, 'went' (verb, past tense) [去了]
tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般] · also with Ming 那 ('that'), before a noun: tere deleme üge
aγ̇ur: aγ̇ur — mortar, pounding-mill (noun; Ming 碓, a treadle pestle-mill; elsewhere aγ̇ur(i)-jan before the reflexive means 'breath, rage', where the sense differs) [碓]
ajužu: aju- — to fear, be afraid; converb -žu, 'fearing' (verb, converb) [怕著︀]
bolγan: bol- — to become; causative -γa- plus -n, 'making, treating as'; converb (verb, causative converb) [做] · also Ming 審 'scrutinise', glossing the whole word; the reading stays 'making' (uncertain)

sedkižü: sedki- — to think; converb -žü, 'thinking' (verb, converb) [想着]
dura: dura — heart, mind, will (noun) [心] · also, with the Ming 惡 'evil, foul' written over it, dura in dotora dura bulγaba, 'revulsion' with bulγaba 心了 [惡]
barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]

aisu: aisu- — to come (verb, stem; the ending is unclear, the Ming has 來有 'there is coming') [來有]
olon: olon — many (adjective or quantifier; Ming 多) [多]
keġekü: keġe- — to say; participle -kü, '(what) is said' (verb, participle) [(說)的]
ese-ü: ese — not (negative of the past); -ü, a question particle (Ming 不曾 … 麽) (negative + particle) [不曾] · also ese-ü with the Ming 不曾 only and no 麽, so the question force is uncertain
γaγčaγ̇ar: γaγča — single, alone; instrumental -γar, 'by oneself' (adjective + case; Ming 獨自) [獨自]
sübeġetei: Sübeġetei — Sübegetei, a man's name (personal name; the first half of Sübeġetei-Baγ̇atur, cut at a line end; the title baγ̇atur 'hero' follows) [人名]
qojar-un: qojar — two; genitive -un, 'of the two' (numeral + case; Ming 兩的) [兩的]
jabužu: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -žu, 'going' (verb, converb) [行着]

qamsažu: qamsa- — to join, combine (stem inferred from the Ming 併); converb -žu, 'joining' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [併着]
kibčaγ̇ud-i: Kibčaγ̇ — the Kipchaks, a people (Ming 種名); plural -ud; accusative -i, the object marker (Ming 行) (people name + plural + case) [種名 行]
olžu: ol- — to find, to get; converb -žu, 'finding' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [得着]
ešige-jin: ešige — young ram, lamb (Ming 小羖); genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [小羖的]
üdüġüj-e: üdüġüi — not yet (Ming 未); -e: dative-locative (j is a glide) [未(行)]

ger-tēče: ger — tent, home; ablative -tēče, 'from the home' (long-vowel spelling of -teče; noun + case; Ming 家 處) [家 處]
γarču: γar- — to go out; converb -ču, 'going out' (verb, converb) [出着] · also γar- 'to go up, come up' (Ming 上着) [上着]
jaγ̇u: jaγ̇u — what, how (interrogative) [怎] · also 'what' (Ming 甚), in jaγ̇u keġeldüleġei 'what we said together' · also 'anything', with ber … ese (Ming 甚麽), jaγ̇u ber … ese 'not anything'

daγ̇u: daγ̇u — time, occasion (noun; Ming 遍 'times') [遍] · also 'voice, sound' (Ming 聲), as in büleġür-ün daγ̇u, 'the sound of the churner' · also 'voice, word, message' (Ming 敎 'cause', as in daγ̇u bariγ̇ulurun; uncertain) [敎]
irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]

delegei: delegei — the earth, the world (Ming 天下 'under heaven') (noun) [天下]
teli: teli — that matter (reading uncertain; sense from the Ming 那事) (noun) [那事]
keġeleġei: keġe- — to say; -leġei, past ending of a question, 'did (you) say?' (verb, past question; the Ming 說來麽) [說來麽] · also without 麽 (Ming 說來), a plain past, 'said' (uncertain)
